instructions_g1.text:
In this block, your partner will be expressing concepts by only using gestures and movements of their upper body. Your task is to guess the meaning of the performance by typing the answer on the keyboard. You will be asked to type the answer only after your partner finished their performance.

You have only one try and we will not tell you whether you were correct or incorrect. However, try to not think about it too much and go with your intuition. It can be any type of word (noun, verb, adjective etc.), but it is always only one word.

During the game, do not talk or interact with your partner.

instructions_p1.text:
In this block, your task is to perform the meanings you will see on the screen in front of you, only by using gestures and movements of your upper body.

You have to follow these rules: 

You can make movements with your hands and upper body
You cannot point to objects on you and in your environment – imagine you are naked and have no objects around you. You can only point to parts of your body.
You must not make any sounds

After you finish your performance, your partner will be asked to type in their guess. They have only one try and none of you will be informed whether the answer was correct, you will simply continue to next word.

During the game, do not talk or interact with your partner.
